messages:
nina chen: planning note — Datadog wants a joint announcement for the OTLP -> Datadog exporter + dashboard bundle. need ops checklist + embargo plan. who's on call for smoke tests? :loudspeaker:
ben park: I can own smoke tests + tech checklist. propose: 1) ingest smoke 2) dashboard rendering 3) alert firing 4) marketplace tile verification. timeline?
sara li: marketing wants 2-week lead time for assets (blog, screenshots, press blurb). embargo date target = 2026-04-22. we'll need final screenshots and a short quote from DD by 04/15.
nina chen: ok. ben please run smoke-runbook and post results in this thread by 04/12. sara, can you draft the announcement outline and share required asset list?
ben park: will do. smoke-run steps I'll include: curl OTLP sample -> confirm spans visible; run generator at low/high rate -> check panels update; flip alert threshold -> expect test alert in Datadog test monitor. will post commands and expected outputs.
deploy-bot: staging cluster provisioned: dd-announce-1759001111 (k8s ns=announce-demo, otelcol pods=2/2).
sara li: also recommend a short embed clip (30s) for sales. partnerships can own the clip; marketing will produce the long-form blog. include embargo instructions and partner quoting policy in the PRD.
nina chen: I'll coordinate partner approvals and legal signoff. action items: ben=smoke-runbook (by 04/12), sara=asset list + draft (by 04/10), nina=partner legal + approvals (by 04/14). We'll reconvene 04/13 for a final dry-run. :calendar:
